profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer II, Payments Onboarding Team
• Contributed to the Vrbo Monetization project by integrating Adyen and JPMC into the payment onboarding system, migrating around 400,000 accounts through large-scale API workflows to enable reliable end-to-end payments
• Integrated internal API clients into the migration processor to retrieve Vrbo host data and created a shared library to standardize models, contracts, and behavior across services in the payment provider migration
• Implemented onboarding adapter endpoints for the payment migration project to enable KYC data transfer between Expedia and Adyen, including legal entity updates and centralized verification error handling

Software Development Engineer I, Policy and Protection Platform Team
• Designed and implemented a Java-based API to retrieve property and tier information for the Partner Tiering Service, which classifies around 400,000 properties into 6 tiers based on performance metrics
• Enhanced backend functionality in Scala by optimizing SQL queries and implementing update workflows for the property tiering database, ensuring consistent property attributes and maintaining database integrity at scale
• Supported development and maintenance of 5 production services within the Marketplace Trust organization by resolving user-reported production issues and ensuring security compliance through upgrading dependencies and patching vulnerabilities

positions.title: Compute and Storage Group Intern
positions.description:
• Developed command-line tools for workflow automation using Python and Apache Airflow to support Apple’s Restricted Vendor Environment
• Migrated Python-based workflows from Airflow to StackStorm to improve automation efficiency

positions.title: Enterprise Infrastructure Operations and Technology Summer Analyst
positions.description:
• Participated in five-week training course over data visualization, AWS, UI/UX, and web applications
• Developed three technical proposals to improve external and internal applications at Citi
• Applied training course lessons to describe feasibility and development process of proposed financial applications

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Automated process to build and boot images with workload manager packages using Python and Jenkins Pipeline
• Migrated Bash scripts for workload manager testing to Jenkins UI to enhance validation of multiple workload manager versions on Cray servers

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted graduate student in robotics research for Graduate Linked with Undergraduate Experience (GLUE)
• Integrated AprilTag detection software and Robot Operating System to track and record movement of AprilTags
• Presented research poster at annual Poster Exhibition on Engineering Research, won third place among GLUE participants

projects.title: Predicting Power Consumption and Energy Resource Distribution
projects.description:
• Built a machine learning model that predicts real-time power distribution data given household power usage
• Developed website using React that describes project and dynamically predicts power data given user input

projects.title: Humanitarian Product Design: Small-scale Wind Turbines for Refugee Camps
projects.description:
• Researched potential for wind energy use in Kutupalong Refugee Camp for International Federation of Red Cross
• Characterized power versus wind speed capability of small commercial wind turbine with Arduino power meter
